label: Charge Blade
note: MH4U endgame Impact Charge Blade core is Honed Blade (Sharpness +1 + Attack Up L), Razor Sharp, Challenger +2, and Artillery Novice, eating for Felyne Bombardier to cap the 40% impact-phial boost; Guard +2 is the common matchup swap for Challenger +2 or Razor Sharp when guard-point counters matter. Ceadeus Regalia is the standard general-purpose impact CB, with Akantor Severance as the high-raw option. Only Honed Blade's always-on components are modeled (sharpness 'best' = Sharpness +1, attackUp 20 = Attack Up L); Honed Blade as a combined skill, Razor Sharp, Challenger +2's enraged Attack Up XL/+20% affinity, Artillery/phial damage, Guard, impact vs element phial type, Load Up, and element-phial sets are unmodeled, and this preset targets impact-phial raw.
